name: mmdpf
description: マルチモーダルデータプラットフォーム

scripts.export: mkdir -p dist && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml build backend frontend && docker save mmdpf-backend:latest | gzip > dist/mmdpf-backend.tar.gz && docker save mmdpf-frontend:latest | gzip > dist/mmdpf-frontend.tar.gz && ls -lh dist/mmdpf-*.tar.gz
scripts.export:backend: mkdir -p dist && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml build backend && docker save mmdpf-backend:latest | gzip > dist/mmdpf-backend.tar.gz && ls -lh dist/mmdpf-backend.tar.gz
scripts.export:frontend: mkdir -p dist && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml build frontend && docker save mmdpf-frontend:latest | gzip > dist/mmdpf-frontend.tar.gz && ls -lh dist/mmdpf-frontend.tar.gz
scripts.export:pull: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml pull --ignore-pull-failures; mkdir -p dist && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml build backend frontend && docker save mmdpf-backend:latest | gzip > dist/mmdpf-backend.tar.gz && docker save mmdpf-frontend:latest | gzip > dist/mmdpf-frontend.tar.gz && ls -lh dist/mmdpf-*.tar.gz
